title: fix: bill the z-image fal fallback from fal's billed megapixels
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reads `x-fal-billable-units` from fal and records our fal cost from it. Fal rounds each image up to whole megapixels (512² → 1, 1024×1536 → 2), so the request-size estimate undercounted fal cost by ~14% (Sep 18–24: fal $11.91, recorded $10.19).
- Adds `TrackingData.pricingInput` so image/video handlers can refine pricing input from the provider's response.
- User price is unchanged: callers keep zimage's flat price.
- Adds the rule "bill from provider-reported usage" to AGENTS.md, `model-management` and `quest-solution-review`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Staging `aae96d59…`, 1024×1536 | served by `z-image-turbo:fal` |
| Tinybird `total_cost` | 0.01 (the old estimate would record 0.00786) |
| fal usage API, 15:29 UTC | 2 MP, $0.01 |
| Tests | gen image/video/fallback: 663 of 663 pass; `tsc` clean |

Other fal integrations were audited and need no change. Krea, MiniMax, Wan 3, the 3D models and stable-audio are billed on a flat or request-echoed quantity that matches fal exactly. The Qwen models switch over in #15236.

gist.headline: Megapixels Counted Properly
gist.blurb: Polli found a few fractional megapixels hiding between the petals. z-image’s fal fallback now records the whole-megapixel usage fal actually reports, while the price at the hive stays exactly the same.
gist.summary: The z-image-turbo:fal fallback now reads fal’s x-fal-billable-units response header and records provider-reported whole-megapixel cost—such as 2 MP for a 1024×1536 image—instead of an undercounting request-size estimate.
gist.impact: Callers keep z-image’s existing flat price, while internal usage tracking now matches fal’s billed quantities for each generated image.
